name: Rifleman
_note: A class is a soldier plus a kit — which is what `extends` is for, and what `slots.json`'s `infantry` note means by *'a class asset is a loadout and a silhouette rather than a stat block'*. Everything about how this man moves comes from `core:soldier`; the only thing added is what is in his hands.
_derived: He can `fire` because he carries something in `ranged_slow`, and he can `dig` because the entrenching tool is in `melee_light`, which C4's registry review put under both `melee` and `dig`. Neither is written down anywhere — take the shovel out of the kit below and he stops being able to dig, in the same edit, with no second list to keep in step.
